def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    fits = bins >= item
    ratios = np.where(fits, item / bins, np.inf)
    priorities = np.where(fits, -np.abs(ratios - 0.5), -np.inf)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(remaining, -np.inf)
    # Avoid division by zero and penalize very small remaining capacities
    safe_remaining = np.where(remaining < 1e-8, 1e-8, remaining)
    ratio = item / safe_remaining
    # Invert ratio to make higher efficiency (lower ratio) better
    priority_scores[valid] = -ratio[valid]
    return priority_scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    ratio = np.where(valid, item / remaining, 0)
    return np.where(valid, -ratio, -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    prio = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    prio[mask] = -(bins[mask] - item)
    return prio
